text:
Alex: pushed raven-lite-q4-ptq to canary on dedicated pool. Seeing funcall structured output failures in streaming responses. sample below.

Maria: which test set? full eval or canary traffic?

Alex: small synthetic harness + canary traffic. failures ~1.7% funcall parse errors, mostly truncated JSON suffix or trailing \u0000 control char. example:

`````
{"action": "search", "args": {"q": "api latency"}
\u0000
`````

Chen: interesting — control char suggests runtime streaming chunk boundary. did you try disabling streaming or increasing chunk size?

Alex: yes, disabling streaming kills the failure but increases P50 by ~40ms. Increasing stream chunk from 8k->32k reduces failures but does not eliminate them.

Eva: we saw something similar with int8 PTQ where KV-cache alignment plus stream flush led to early EOF. did you run tokenizer/byte-compare against fp16 baseline?

Alex: ran weight checksum and tokenizer hash; both match. hypothesis: quantized kernel emits a trailing null when sequence boundary aligns weirdly with subtokenization. also saw duplicate tool invocations because client retry budget kicks in on parse error.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy raven-lite-q4-ptq -> succeeded (2024-04-12T09:41Z)

Maria: proposal: 1) add a streaming sentinel wrapper that ensures JSON wrapper is closed before emitting final flush. 2) server-side postprocess trap: strip control chars and attempt minimal heal (append closing brace) before parse failure surfaces. 3) metric: emit "parse_heal_attempt" + "heal_success" counters.

Chen: add a lightweight parse-healer with heuristics: remove trailing control chars, try appending common closers ("}", "]"), and if still failing, mark as unrecoverable. Log original vs healed payload for audit. Also add flag to opt-out per model.

Eva: i'll schedule a canary eval job that replays canary traffic with strict schema checker and records healed vs unrecoverable counts and duplicate-tool-invoke incidence. want to capture latency delta when healing is applied.

Alex: i'll open a PR with the sentinel wrapper and a minimal postprocess healer. will add tests: unit on examples + integration that toggles streaming on/off. tagging @Maria for canary config changes. :thumbsup:

Maria: sounds good — keep the change behind a config toggle and a quick kill-switch. once PR is up we can run the replay eval and decide whether to merge to dedicated.

Chen: quick ask — can someone grep for other models with similar failure pattern in the last 7 days? if pattern exists we should broad-scope the healer.

Alex: will run grep and post results here in a follow-up.

Eva: thanks all, i'll create the eval job and share dashboard link when ready.
